doc.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Israel Baptist Church and its gospel influence
summary: She played Sunday school and church on the pipe organ at Israel Baptist until eighteen, and says gospel shaped her playing.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Would you say that you grew up in the church? I mean, you were the pianist. Was it a solid . . . you know that church upbringing that you can‘t get . . .

Child, I was there when I was . . . at Israel Baptist Church. I think you know about Israel Baptist Church, okay? So I played for Sunday school and church. I played . . . let‘s see, they didn‘t have the B-3 organ. I played the pipe organ, right? I did all that, because I was there all day and all, and I did the whole nine yards. Child, believe me, I was there until I was eighteen.
What impact do you think this had on your music?
Oh, hey, it made a difference, you know?

Oh, hey, because it affected me right on down the line, up and down the line, right? I just, I heard it. I heard it all, you know. Well, sometimes you listen out, I‘ll be throwing a little something in there, you know.
